source: 618 Divination Ritual
target: 618 Ritus Divinationis

source: Franca’s request met with a gentle shake of Naboredisley’s head.
target: Petitum Francae obvenit leni gyratione capitis Naboredisley.

source: “You can request the deity you believe in to bear witness when signing the contract, but I don’t want anyone else present.”
target: “Deum, in quem fidem habes, petere potes ut testis fiat dum pactum signas, sed nolo ut alii adsint.”

source: A chuckle escaped Naboredisley’s lips.
target: Risus levis ex labris Naboredisley effugit.

source: “I’m a Demon.
target: Daemon sum.

source: I need to be careful to avoid becoming prey.”
target: Caveo ne praeda fias.

source: We can recite a god’s name as a witness when signing the contract?
target: Possumusne nomen dei pronuntiare ut testis, dum pactum subscribimus?

source: The temptation loomed over them both.
target: Tentatio super eos ambo imminebat.

source: For ordinary Beyonders who held faith in the Eternal Blazing Sun or the God of Steam and Machinery, invoking a deity’s name as a witness might offer no more than psychological comfort.
target: Nam Beyonders vulgares, qui fidem habebant in Sole Aeterno Ardente aut in Deo Vaporis et Machinarum, per invocationem nominis dei, ut testis, nihil praeter solacium psychologicum praestare possent.

source: True gods rarely intervened in such trivial affairs of ordinary Beyonders without a proper ritual.
target: Vere dii raro in talibus rebus trivialibus Beyonders vulgares interveniebant, sine rito proprio.

source: Yet, as Minor Arcana card holders of the Tarot Club, Lumian and Franca followed the great existence, Mr. Fool.
target: Sed ut tenentes chartarum Minorum Arcanorum in Societate Taroti, Lumian et Franca magnam existentiam, Domine Stultus, secuti sunt.

source: Simply invoking his name could draw attention, a fact not lost on them.
target: Simpliciter eius nomine invocato, attentionem allicere poterat, et hoc eis notum erat.

source: Franca’s heart raced with uncertainty.
target: Cor Francae incertitudine palpitabat.

source: Should she strike a deal with the Demon under the watchful gaze of Mr. Fool, in exchange for elusive benefits?
target: Num pactum faciat cum Daemone sub vigilantia Domini Stulti, pro beneficiis fugacibus?

source: Naboredisley reiterated his stance.
target: Naboredisley iterum suam sententiam enuntiavit.

source: “This is a fair transaction.
target: “Haec est transactio aequa.

source: There’s no coercion.
target: Nulla coactio est.

source: It’s the same for you and me.
target: Idem est tibi ac mihi.

source: If you insist that there must be a powerful witness present, I choose to give up.”
target: Si persistas ut adsit testis potens, ego opto cedere.”

source: Just as Lumian contemplated the idea, Termiboros’s resounding voice echoed within his mind, “It’s best if you don’t agree. Don’t even make a false promise.”
target: Dum Lumian de ea cogitabat, vox sonans Termiborosis in mente eius resonabat: “Optime est, si non consentis; ne falsam quidem promissionem facias.”

source: Lumian found himself taken aback as Termiboros, an Angel of Inevitability, unexpectedly warned him about the unfolding situation.
target: Lumian obstupefactus est, cum Termiboros, Angelus Inevitabilitatis, eum inopinanter de eventu monuerit.

source: Alarmed, Lumian pushed aside thoughts of Termiboros’s possible intentions, choosing instead to focus on scrutinizing Naboredisley’s every move and assessing his own mental state.
target: Territus, Lumian cogitationibus de intensionibus Termiborosis deponit, et potius se vertit ad perscrutandum omnem motum Naboredisley atque ad aestimandam suam mentis condicionem.

source: The more Lumian delved into the matter, the more alarmed he became.
target: Quo magis Lumian in rem intuebatur, eo magis territus factus est.

source: Initially planning to teleport away immediately and seek help, he and Franca had gradually shifted their stance, considering Naboredisley’s propositions and exploring potential exploitations.
target: Primum, cum consiliis statim discedendi et auxilium quaerendi, ille et Franca gradatim suam positionem mutaverant, propositiones Naboredisley considerantes atque opportunitates explorantes.

source: Their plan had evolved from seeking the presence of a powerful Arbiter like Madam Judgment as a witness to contemplating a deal without one.
target: Consilium eorum evoluta est, ab quaerendo praesentiam Arbiteris validi, ut Domina Iudicium, pro testimonium, ad cogitandum pactum sine eo conversum.

source: Now, all they hoped was to ensure their safety by invoking a god’s name.
target: Iam solum id sperabant ut salutem suam assecurarent, invocando nomen dei.

source: Compromising one step at a time, changing bit by bit…
target: Unum gradum singillatim, paulatim variando…

source: This is very similar to Naboredisley’s description of degenerating bit by bit, slowly rotting one’s soul before ultimately plunging into the Abyss…
target: Hoc est simile narrationi Naboredisley de paulatim degenerando, animam paulatim putrescente antequam tandem in Abyssum immitatur…

source: It also said that Demons aren’t just about the body but also about the mind…
target: Item dictum est daemonia non solum ad corpus, sed etiam ad mentem pertinere…

source: Lumian swiftly snapped out of his reverie, sensing a possible influence from Naboredisley on both himself and Franca.
target: Lumian celeriter ex sua meditatione evasit, intuens possibilem influentiam Naboredisley in se et in Francam.

source: It resembled the signs of a Spectator’s presence.
target: Hoc simile erat signis praesentiae Spectatoris.

source: Similarly, he could glean insights through Anthony’s self-examination technique.
target: Similiter, per artem sui ipsius examinandi, quam Antonius exercet, notitias colligere poterat.

source: Even in this state, Franca displayed remarkable control over her emotions.
target: Etiam in hoc statu, Franca eminet imperium super affectus suos ostendit.

source: She turned to Lumian, seeking agreement.
target: Se versa ad Lumian, consensum petens.

source: With thoughts racing, the corners of Lumian’s mouth curled up slightly as he addressed Naboredisley.
target: Mentibus ferventibus, anguli oris Lumiani paulum incurvabantur quam dum ad Naboredisley loquebatur.

source: “We don’t require a witness, but I need to confirm something first.”
target: “Testis non nobis requiritur, sed primum aliquid confirmare mihi oportet.”

source: “What is it?” Naboredisley’s demeanor remained cold, yet his attitude was composed.
target: “Quid est?” inquit Naboredisley; habitus eius frigidus manebat, sed animus eius compositus erat.

source: Lumian nodded at Franca, conveying that he would handle the situation.
target: Lumian Francae annuit, significans se rem expediendum se curaturum.

source: Franca, in turn, silently acknowledged her understanding.
target: Franca silentio suam comprehensionem agnovit.

source: Turning back to Naboredisley, Lumian stated, “I need to verify that the name you’re using now, the name you’ll use in the contract later, is indeed your real name.”
target: Conversus ad Naboredisley, Lumian ait: “Mihi necesse est probare nomen, quod nunc uteris et in pacto postea adhibebis, vere nomen tuum esse.”

source: Deliberately avoiding the term “Naboredisley,” Lumian exercised caution to mitigate potential risks.
target: Cautissime vitans vocabulum “Naboredisley”, Lumian id prudenter egit, ut pericula possibilia minueret.

source: Naboredisley pondered for a moment before responding, “Sure. As a Demon, I don’t just dislike but also admire your caution.”
target: Naboredisley paulisper meditatus respondit: “Certe. Daemon sum; non solum detestor, sed etiam tuam cautelam admiror.”

source: Lumian maintained his smirk.
target: Lumian subrisum suum conservavit.

source: “The way to confirm is Magic Mirror Divination, a complete one.
target: “Modus confirmandi est Divinatio Speculi Magici, completa.

source: We’ll set up a ritual and seek answers from a hidden entity.
target: Ritum instituemus et responsa a re abscondita quaeremus.

source: As you know, my friend is a Demoness.
target: Ut nosti, amica mea Daemona est.

source: She’s quite skilled at this.”
target: Ea hac re optime versata est.

source: Lumian pointed at Franca as he spoke.
target: Lumian in Francam monstravit, dum loquebatur.

source: Indeed… we should confirm if Naboredisley is the Demon’s real name.
target: Vere… debemus confirmare utrum Naboredisley verum Daemoni nomen sit.

source: Otherwise, the deal would be a joke…
target: Aliter, res illud iocus esset…

source: Franca suddenly became alert, realizing she had been too eager to conclude the deal and had overlooked many potentially problematic details.
target: Subito Franca vigilans facta est, intellegens se nimis festinasse ad pactum concludendum et multas rebus problematicis neglexisse.

source: Naboredisley pondered for a moment before agreeing, “Alright, but I have to observe from within the wall of spirituality where the ritual takes place.
target: Naboredisley paulisper meditatus est antequam assentivit: “Recte, sed mihi ex pariete spiritualitatis, ubi ritus perficitur, observare debeo.

source: “This is a Demon’s caution. We’re worried that you’ll use Magic Mirror Divination to inform certain Demons’ natural enemies.”
target: “Haec est cautela Daemoni. Nos metimus te Divinationem Speculi Magici ad certos naturales inimicos daemonum nuntiare venturum.”

source: “No problem,” Lumian said with a bright smile.
target: “Nullum est,” inquit Lumian, subridente laete.

source: “To complete Magic Mirror Divination, I want you to write your real name on this note and bring over the ancient notebook from the opposite room.
target: “Ad perficiendam Divinationem Speculi Magici, volo ut nomen tuum verum in hoc chirographo scribas et codicem antiquum ex conclavi opposito afferas.

source: Naboredisley, well-versed in the intricacies of complete Magic Mirror Divination, responded with a smile, “No problem.”
target: Naboredisley, bene versatus in subtilitatibus Divinationis Speculi Magici completae, respondit subridente: “Nullum est.”

source: He stood up, taking the note from Lumian’s hand.
target: Surrexit, accipiens schedulam de manu Lumiani.

source: Using Flores’s fountain pen, he inscribed a complex word with the pronunciation “Naboredisley,” its language unknown.
target: Utens calamo Florensis, verbum compositum cum pronuntiatione “Naboredisley” inscripsit, cuius lingua ignota erat.

source: The self-proclaimed Demon then left for Flores’s rented apartment, retrieving the ancient notebook and the note.
target: Daemon, se ipse proclamans, deinde abiit ad domum conducendam Florensis, recuperans codicem antiquum et schedulam.

source: Lumian had already arranged a simple ritual, placing three candles and a mirror on an empty table.
target: Lumian iam ritum simplicem instituerat, tres candelas et speculum in mensa vacua posuit.

source: Before Naboredisley returned, Franca approached him and whispered, “The usual Magic Mirror Divination target?”
target: Antequam Naboredisley rediret, Franca accessit eumque susurravit: “Scopus solitus Divinationis Speculi Magici?”

source: Lumian shook his head, indicating they weren’t.
target: Lumian caput negavit, indicans eos non esse.

source: Softly uttering a single word, he said, “Him.”
target: Leniter unum verbum pronuntians, dixit: “Eum.”

source: A pure male pronoun.
target: Pronominum masculinum purum.

source: Franca’s pupils dilated as she tacitly understood whom Lumian was referring to.
target: Pupillae Francae dilatatae sunt, cum tacite intellexit ad quem Lumian referebat.

source: The implications were self-evident!
target: Implicationes manifestae erant!

source: After Naboredisley handed her the ancient notebook, Franca smiled happily and said, “Demons are likely higher-level godhood creatures.
target: Postquam Naboredisley ei codicem antiquum tradidit, Franca laetissima risit et dixit: “Daemones fortasse sunt creaturae divinitatis altioris.

source: I can’t afford to be negligent.
target: Neglegere mihi non licet.

source: I plan to seek answers from a more special entity.
target: Proposito meo est responsa ab entitate speciali quaerere.

source: Inevitably, my companion will need to assist me during the ritual.
target: Inevitabiliter, comes meus mihi in ritu auxilium ferre debebit.

source: I hope you can understand what you’ll see next.
target: Spero te intellegere posse quid deinceps videbis.

source: If you’re unwilling, we’ll abandon this transaction.
target: Si nolueris, hanc transactionem relinquemus.

source: She didn’t make it sound too firm, making the “abandon the transaction” option seem more like a negotiating strategy.
target: Ea non ita firmiter pronuntiavit, ita ut optio “transactionem relinquere” magis ut consilium tractationis appareret.

source: Naboredisley smiled and replied, “No problem. I’ve seen too many special rituals.”
target: Naboredisley subridente respondit: “Nullum est; plurimos ritus peculiares vidi.”

source: His implication was clear—if there was a problem with your ritual, I would be able to tell immediately.
target: Eius implicatio erat manifesta—si quaestio de tuo ritu oriretur, statim id agnoscerem.

source: Franca sanctified the ritual silver dagger and created a wall of spirituality.
target: Franca sanctificavit pugionem argenteum ritualem et murum spiritualitatis condidit.

source: Lumian placed the ancient notebook and the note with the real name in front of the lit candle and mirror, using a small amount of Gardner Martin’s spiritual blood to draw a few complicated and strange symbols.
target: Lumian codicem antiquum et schedulam, cui nomen verum inscriptum erat, ante candelam accensam et speculum posuit, parva quantitate sanguinis spiritualis Gardner Martin utens ad complura symbola perplexa et insolita delineanda.

source: Observing from a distance, Naboredisley muttered, “Seeking guidance from fate… Questioning an entity in this domain?”
target: A longe observans, Naboredisley submurmuravit: “Consilium a fato quaero… Interrogans entitatem in hoc regno?”

source: Lumian seized the opportunity to turn around and ask, “What can I do to dispel Salah’s infatuation with Flores?”
target: Lumian occasionem rapuit ad se convertere et rogavit: “Quid facere possum ut infatuationem Salah erga Flores deluderim?”

source: Naboredisley smiled meaningfully and said, “Either they both perish, or they seek my approval.”
target: Naboredisley subrisit signanter et inquit: “Aut uterque peribit, aut approbationem meam quaeret.”

source: With the preparations complete, Franca stepped back, gazing at the three burning candles and the palm-sized makeup mirror.
target: Cum omnia parata essent, Franca recedebat, intuens tres candelas ardentes et speculum parvum, simile palmae magnitudine.

source: She recited an honorific name in ancient Hermes.
target: Ea nomen honorificum in antiquo Hermetis recitavit.

source: “The Fool that doesn’t belong to this era…”
target: “Stultus, qui huic aetati non competit…”

source: Upon hearing this, Naboredisley’s expression changed.
target: Hoc audito, vultus Naboredisley mutatus est.

source: His face turned icy, and his eyes revealed a chilling cruelty.
target: Facies eius frigida facta est, et oculi eius crudelitatem terribilem patefecerunt.

source: Just as he was about to project Lumian and Franca’s figures in his eyes and ignite their desires and emotions, he realized that a thin gray fog emanated, making the two targets indistinct and challenging to lock onto.
target: Ita ut iam proximus esset figuras Lumiani et Francae in oculis suis proicere atque eorum desideria et affectus excitare, intellexit tenuem nebulam griseam emanare, quae utrumque scopum indistincte effecit et assequi laborebat.

source: Lumian gripped Franca’s forearm.
target: Lumian Francae antebrachium ceperat.

source: In mysticism, this signified that the two people in the ritual were one.
target: In mystica, hoc significabat duas personas in ritu unum esse.

source: Of course, the prerequisite was that the original ritual host didn’t resist.
target: Certe, praerequisitum erat ut hospes originalis ritu non repugneret.

source: Lumian took over the ritual host’s position and recited the last two paragraphs.
target: Lumian locum hospitis rituum suscepit atque duas ultimas partes recitavit.

source: “The mysterious ruler above the gray fog; the King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck…”
target: “Dominus arcanus super nebulam griseam; Rex Flavus et Niger, qui fortunam imperat…”

source: The thick gray fog surged even more visibly, and Naboredisley, manipulating Flores’s body, grew increasingly malevolent.
target: Nebula grisea densa etiam magis conspicue apparuit, et Naboredisley, corpus Floris regens, malevolentiam augebat.

source: He tried to break free from the altar, attempting to shatter the wall of spirituality, but the gray fog stood as an impenetrable obstacle.
target: Conatus est ab altare liberari, murum spiritualitatis perrumpere temptans, sed nebula grisea quasi obstaculum impenetrabile stabat.

source: Lumian advanced two steps, presenting the note with the real name to the candle symbolizing the ritual’s host.
target: Lumian duos gradus processit, schedulam cui nomen verum inscriptum erat ad candelam, quae hospitem rituum repraesentabat, exhibens.

source: He ignited it and flicked it three times, dispersing ashes onto the ancient notebook.
target: Illam accendit et ter pulsavit, cineres in codicem antiquum diffundens.

source: After these preparations, Lumian spoke in a deep voice, “I beseech your assistance. I implore you to banish the creature named Naboredisley…”
target: Post hos praeparatos, Lumian voce profunda dixit: “Auxilium tuum oro. Te obsecro, expelle creaturam, quae ‘Naboredisley’ nominatur…”

source: Naboredisley, in control of Flores’s body, opened his mouth, emitting a sharp cry.
target: Naboredisley, corpus Floris regens, os aperuit et acutum clamor edidit.

source: Simultaneously, filth, depravity, and evil ravings echoed in Lumian and Franca’s ears.
target: Simul, sordes, pravitas, et malefica deliria in auribus Lumiani et Francae resonaverunt.

source: Each word seemed to assault their minds, causing their bodies to contort and their souls to decay.
target: Singula verba animos eorum oppugnare videbantur, corpora eorum contorti facientes ac animas eorum putrescere.

source: Yet, under the ritual’s shield and the layers of gray fog, the words appeared distant, as if emanating from the horizon.
target: Attamen, sub scuto rituali et stratis nebulae griseae, verba remota videbantur, quasi ab horizonte emanarent.

source: Even if Lumian and Franca strained to listen, the specifics eluded them.
target: Etiam, si Lumian et Franca auscultare conabantur, singula eis evanuerunt.

source: Amidst a faint shriek, pitch‑black gas emanated from Flores’s body, swiftly dissipating.
target: Inter tenuem stridorem, gas nigerrimus ex corpore Floris emanavit, celeriter dissipans.

source: Faces emerged from the pitch‑black gas, mouths opening and closing, cursing Lumian and Franca vehemently, only to dissolve into the gray fog.
target: Vultus ex gasi nigerrimo orti sunt, ora aperiens atque claudens, Lumian et Francam vehementer maledicentes, solum ut in nebulam griseam dissolverentur.

source: In a matter of seconds, the pitch‑black gas completely vanished, and Flores’s demeanor and aura returned to normal.
target: In paucis secundis, gas nigerrimus omnino evanuit, et habitus atque aura Floris ad statum normalem redierunt.

source: Exorcism Spell!
target: Exorcismus!

source: In just a few days, Lumian had employed the Exorcism Spell once more!
target: In paucis diebus, Lumian iterum incantationem exorcismi adhibuit!

source: From his perspective, Naboredisley, hiding his true form somewhere, had stealthily infiltrated Flores’s breath for control.
target: Ex sua parte, Naboredisley, veram formam alicubi celans, subdolus spiritum Floris ad dominationem insinuaverat.

source: He was akin to a Wraith evil spirit possessing another.
target: Ille erat quasi umbra, spiritus malignus alterum possidens.

source: Most surprising was the effectiveness of the name Naboredisley!
target: Maxime mirabile erat efficacitas nominis Naboredisley!

source: Of course, if this wasn’t the true name, if the Exorcism Spell proved futile, Lumian could resort to Mr. Fool’s complete honorific name to intimidate the Demon and drive it away with the gray fog and the gaze of a great existence.
target: Certe, si hoc non esset verum nomen, si incantatio exorcismi futilis esset, Lumian ad totum nomen honorificum Domini Stulti confugere potuisset, ut Daemonem intimaret et eum nebulā griseā atque aspectu magni existentiae expelleret.

source: This time, it wasn’t Mr. Fool’s seal on his chest that answered, but the great existence himself!
target: Hoc tempore, non sigillum Domini Stulti in pectore illius respondit, sed ipsa magna existentia!

source: Lumian forced a smile and said to Franca, “This fellow is less formidable than the invisible Child of God of the Great Mother.”
target: Lumian subrisum compulit et Francae ait: “Hic homo minus formidabilis est quam Infans Dei invisibilis Matris Magnae.”

source: Despite Naboredisley’s frenzied curse affecting his desires and emotions, requiring him to endure with his Ascetic powers, it still paled in comparison to the invisible Child of God’s ability to partially breach the gray fog’s protection of the ritual host, repeatedly creating a Psychic Piercing effect.
target: Quamquam furiosa maledictio Naboredisley, quae desideria et affectus eius afficiebat atque eum virtutibus asceticis pati faciebat, adhuc parum videbatur comparata cum facultate Infantis Dei invisibilis, quae ad defensionem nebulae griseae hospitis rituum partim irrumpere poterat atque effectus psychicas percussiones iteratas creabat.

source: Franca remained silent, her gaze fixed on the makeup mirror serving as decoration.
target: Franca silentium retinuit, oculi eius in speculo ornamento fungente fixa erant.

source: In the mirror, a faint fog permeated the air, and a vague figure approached from a distance.
target: In speculo, nebulula tenuis aerem pervasit, et figura vaga ex longinquo accessit.
